description: We are looking for a Python developer to build our internal tools platform. You will work with Django, PostgreSQL, and Docker in a small team. 1-2 years of experience is enough if you are eager to learn. Remote-friendly within Finland.
10+ years of experience designing distributed systems. You will lead a team of 20 engineers building the next generation platform. Must be a German citizen with security clearance.
Looking for a senior React developer to build our customer-facing dashboard. Experience with TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS required.

Join our data platform team. We use Python, SQL, Airflow, and dbt. You will build ETL pipelines and data warehouses. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) is a plus. We offer visa sponsorship for the right candidate.
Build LLM-powered internal tools for our consulting clients. Python, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines. We care about results, not years of experience. Fully remote with flexible hours.
